title: Gadi Eisenkot Couldn’t Be More Unlike Netanyahu. Can He Beat Him?
summary_full: Mr. Eisenkot, an ex-military chief leading in the polls, calls the Israeli prime minister an “anti-leader.” But his low-key campaigning style is worrying supporters.
